parsed.claim_reason: A nonincreasing sequence starting above 1 can drop to 1 or below. Nonincreasing plus q_1 > 1 does not prevent q_2 <= 1; nothing in the hypotheses enforces a positive lower bound above 1.
parsed.witness_reason: The sequence has positive terms, q_1 = 2 > 1, and q_{k+1} <= q_k throughout (1 <= 2, then 1 <= 1). Yet q_2 = 1, violating the conclusion q_k > 1.
